description:
List highlight links (insight threads) in a document with pagination.

Returns up to 'limit' links (default 50, max 100) starting from 'offset'.
Use has_more and next_offset to paginate through all links.
Each link has a type: 'related', 'supports', 'contradicts', 'expands', or 'questions'.

params.description: Parameters for listing highlight links in a document.

document_id.description: Document UUID - returns links where this document is the source OR target

name: highlyt_list_highlight_links
title: List Highlight Links
